SELECT co.name AS empresa, 'pre_reserva' AS automacao, s.is_enabled, s.hours_before_expiry::text AS horas, NULL::text AS segunda_msg,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pre_reservations p WHERE p.company_id = co.id AND p.status = 'ativa')::text AS ativas
FROM pre_reservation_settings s JOIN companies co ON co.id = s.company_id
UNION ALL
SELECT co.name, 'confirmacao_visita', v.is_enabled, v.hours_before_visit::text, v.second_message_enabled::text,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_visits lv WHERE lv.company_id = co.id AND lv.visit_type = 'atendimento' AND lv.visit_date >= current_date - 60)::text
FROM visit_confirmation_settings v JOIN companies co ON co.id = v.company_id
ORDER BY 2, 1
